remarks: Welcome to this charming Downey home featuring elegant crown moldings and beautiful wood laminate flooring throughout. The inviting layout offers a separate dining room, perfect for gatherings and entertaining. The kitchen features quartz countertops, a separate island, and a convenient breakfast counter, providing both style and functionality. The spacious primary bedroom includes a private bathroom with dual sinks and a dedicated vanity area. Conveniently located near the 105 Freeway, offering easy access to surrounding areas, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities. Don't miss the opportunity to make this lovely home your own!
